title: Elementary and Early Childhood Education, B.S. (College of Education)
notes: University Park, single pathway. Ten new departments were entirely missing from the catalog (EDTHP, EDUC, MTHED, EDPSY, CI, ECE, LLED, SSED, SCIED, SPLED) -- added minimal entries across ten new catalog files, sourced from PSU course description pages. Chose 'MATH 200' over 'MTHED 240' for the Semester 1 math item, since MTHED 420 later requires MATH 200 specifically -- this only actually worked once 'MATH' was added to this plan's own departments list (initially omitted, which meant MATH 200 wasn't in the merged catalog at all and the engine's tiered ranking silently fell through to MTHED 240 instead, since 'catalog-present' is a ranking tier, not a hard filter). Real gap fixed: 'ECE 451' requires concurrent enrollment in BOTH EDPSY 11 and HDFS 229, but the bulletin's own Year 2 Fall item only offers 'EDPSY 11 or HDFS 229' as alternatives -- picked EDPSY 11 for that item and added HDFS 229 as an explicit Semester 4 item so ECE 451's real AND requirement is satisfiable. Real data artifact handled: 'CI 495D' cites 'CI 495A; CI 495B' as prereqs, but CI 495B requires admission to the separate Middle Level Education major and doesn't apply here -- treated as a bulletin template artifact and only CI 495A (already in this plan) was modeled. Many 300/400-level education courses list '4th/2nd/7th-semester standing' prereqs the schema doesn't model directly, same limitation as ABSM/TURF's semester-standing courses. Re-verified 2026-08-26 against the live bulletin (all course codes/Gen Ed domains/credits unchanged) and a real, official Penn State College of Education course-selection PDF (sites.psu.edu/educationadvising, 'EECE Approved Course List') that enumerates every one of this plan's generic categories in full: 'Earth Science Selection', 'Physical Science Selection', 'Literature Selection', 'US History Selection', 'Social Studies Selection', and 'Education Selection' (x3) are now wired via `match` to their exact real approved course lists from that PDF (kept alongside their existing gen_ed GN/GH/GS domain wiring, which stays broader than the department's own curated subset but is left in place so recommend_semester still actively recommends a course for these slots -- `match` only tightens progress-crediting/scoring, it doesn't narrow live recommendations, so this is purely additive). 'Math selection' in the bulletin's Semester 1 is modeled directly as the explicit MATH 200/MTHED 240 course item already in this plan, not a separate slot. Post-scraper-fix repair: STAT 200's real prereq is MATH 21, which was never in this plan at all -- and MATH 21 itself real-chains through MATH 4 (Intermediate Algebra) back to MATH 3 (Basic Skills), neither of which were in the plan either, leaving STAT 200 permanently unschedulable. Added all three (MATH 3, MATH 4, MATH 21) as explicit Semester 1 items; confirmed clean (no warnings, goal met) after the addition. (This is a separate, unrelated issue from the TestCreditBillingAnnotation test class's own ELED scenario.)
